summary: Frontend and backend smoke review completed against the public preview URL. Landing, demo session, protected navigation, search/filtering, opportunity detail, apply routing, dashboard, notifications, logout, and responsive menu were exercised; no backend API is used by this mocked frontend.

integration_issues.issue: Save opportunity button has no onClick/state persistence; clicking it produces no observable change, unlike opportunity cards.
Direct /student/signup and /professional/signup routes render the sign-in form (Welcome back) because Auth does not initialize signup mode from the route.

action_items: Wire detail-page save button to skillbridge_saved persistence and saved visual state.
Initialize Auth signup mode from /student/signup and /professional/signup paths, or route those paths to the equivalent signup state.
critical_code_review_comments: The app is entirely local/mock persistence as intended, but several controls are visually presented as functional without handlers (detail save, forgot password, profile/edit and notification actions); ensure demo-critical controls either work or are clearly disabled/labeled.
seed_data_creation: None; used seeded localStorage demo data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified public preview. Demo student flow passed landing -> auth -> home -> opportunities -> research filter -> search -> detail -> apply navigation -> dashboard/notifications -> logout. Professional onboarding and full four-step signup completion were not retested after defects found.
rca of the issue: Auth renders the same component for login and signup paths, while signup is controlled only by internal useState(false); URL path is ignored. Detail save button is rendered without an onClick handler or saved state, so it cannot persist the requested action.
